messages:
Maya (CS): Hi team — quick sync on Pomelo private/VPC onboarding. Account health is OK but they hit a few blockers: the KMS CMK rejected our encrypt/decrypt by the inference role, audit logs to their Splunk endpoint are failing (403), and one subnet route for egress to our proxy is missing. Low renewal risk but want to clear these this week.

Ravi (Solutions): thanks — can you paste the exact KMS error? I can repro with their role.

Maya (CS): error from their console: "AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to use this key" — happened when we ran canary encrypt in their account (role: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/pomelo-redwood-inference).

Theo (Networking): I pulled their VPC config — they forgot the 0.0.0.0/0 route in the private egress route table that points to the NAT in prod-subnet-c. I can add if Pomelo approves.

Sam (Security): KMS common culprits: missing kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt in key policy, missing kms:DescribeKey, or a Deny/Condition on the CMK. Maya, did Pomelo share the CMK policy?

Maya (CS): they pasted this minimal snippet earlier: "{"Sid":"AllowAccountUse","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/pomelo-redwood-inference"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"*"}" — looks fine but maybe CMK has other statements.

Sam (Security): ask them to run `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/pomelo-inference` and paste output. Also ensure the role policy allows kms:DescribeKey on the key ARN.

Ravi (Solutions): repro started — seeing kms:DescribeKey failing first. Preparing a minimal role policy to attach.

Sam (Security): sharing minimal role policy suggestion: "{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}]}" — recommend attach to pomelo-redwood-inference role.

Emma (SRE): on Splunk delivery — 403 usually means our forwarder role can't PutObject or the signed URL expired. Pomelo, can you confirm S3 bucket policy allows `arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/log-forwarder`?

Maya (CS): Pomelo replied: "we allowed redwood-log-forwarder but bucket has BlockPublicAccess & a region deny. Could that block?"

Emma (SRE): BlockPublicAccess is fine. A region-based deny or NotPrincipal could cause 403. Ask them to paste bucket policy or temporarily grant put to our role for a smoke test.

Theo (Networking): Pomelo approved the route change. I'll schedule NAT route addition and will coordinate with their infra channel.

Maya (CS): action items: 1) Ravi to repro KMS and share failing API call (EOD PST). 2) Sam to provide hardened key-policy checklist. 3) Theo to add egress route once approved. 4) Emma to validate S3 bucket policy / Splunk delivery. I'll update the customer ticket and weekly health score.

Ravi (Solutions): update — after adding kms:DescribeKey to role policy, canary encrypt succeeded.

Theo (Networking): route pushed at 1737553000 and NAT egress verified.

Emma (SRE): Splunk delivery validated, logs ingest confirmed.

OpsBot: Deploy notice — `privnet/egress-route` change completed.

Maya (CS): closing blockers. Marking ticket "week0 resolved" and Pomelo green for onboarding health. Low renewal risk confirmed. Will schedule 30-min retro next Thursday to capture feedback and update runbooks.

Ravi (Solutions): will add KMS troubleshooting steps to onboarding playbook.

Sam (Security): added key-policy and role examples to security cookbook.

Maya (CS): thanks team — logging recap in the ticket and closing thread.
